name: AirAsia Group Berhad (formerly AirAsia X Berhad)
note: AirAsia's listed parent on Bursa Malaysia. It completed the acquisition of AirAsia Berhad and AirAsia Aviation Group Limited from Capital A on 18 January 2026, consolidating all AirAsia-branded airlines under a single listed platform (AirAsia statement, 2026-01-18), and completed its name change from AirAsia X Berhad to AirAsia Group Berhad effective 2 July 2026 (AirAsia statement, 2026-07-09). Co-founders Tony Fernandes and Kamarudin Meranun remain substantial shareholders via direct and indirect interests (AirAsia statement, 2026-01-06).
